name: claude-subagent-report-guard
description: Closes a real, reproduced gap in how dispatched Claude Code subagents report back to whoever dispatched them.

plugins.name: subagent-report-guard
plugins.description: Blocks a dispatched Claude Code teammate from going idle without delivering its report, keeps a non-blocking drop-box of every lane's progress, and surfaces a pointer to any subagent report that never reached its dispatcher.
